decisive_items: KDR (VEGFR2) c.C2312G, p.T771R identified as the only somatic mutation
single, well-defined, blanchable bright red plaque densely composed of telangiectasias
response.rationale: The presence of a specific somatic mutation in the KDR (VEGFR2) gene, along with the clinical presentation of a blanchable red plaque composed of telangiectasias, supports the diagnosis of a vascular lesion associated with this genetic finding.

rejected.why: Lack of specific genetic findings to support Cutaneous Angiokeratoma diagnosis
No specific clinical or genetic findings to support Cutaneous Collateral Vessel Formation diagnosis
Histopathological findings, although suggestive of a vascular lesion, do not specifically support Angiosarcoma over other vascular lesions
